offering_description.value: Provides less-than-truckload freight transportation across North America for businesses shipping palletized and smaller freight. It moves shipments through a network of service centers and a fleet of tractors and trailers.

primary_services.value: less-than-truckload freight transportation; regional and interregional freight delivery; freight consolidation

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, retailers, distributors and other businesses shipping freight

end_markets.value: manufacturing; retail; construction; industrial; consumer goods

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-shipment freight charges paid by shippers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: transports shippers' freight, sold to manufacturers, retailers and distributors; asset operator: owns and runs trucks, trailers and service center terminals

geography_served.value: North America: US, Canada and Mexico through a national service center network

specialization.value: niche specialist: LTL freight transportation only, after separating its other logistics businesses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national accounts and shipper contracts sold by its own sales teams; own locations: service center terminals where freight is received and dispatched; online: digital platform for booking and tracking shipments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: DOT and FMCSA safety, driver hours-of-service and vehicle emissions rules

notes: Describes the North American LTL business remaining after the spin-offs of GXO and RXO and the sale of the European operations.
